t1_count_write.request: First write 3 to COUNT. Then capture count, win_wr and the shell's ADDR byte when the shell writes the COUNT register (win_wr is 1 and addr is 0x80), 16 cycles before and 32 after. The write that triggers it puts 0x1234 in COUNT. Afterwards read COUNT back.

t1_pwm_period.request: With COUNT set to 0x8421 and DUTY set to 0x40, record led and phase for one whole PWM period starting when phase wraps to 0: no cycles before the trigger, 1023 after. Then read DUTY and COUNT back.

t1_sync_byte.request: Trigger on the rising edge of rx_valid when the received byte rx_data is 0xA5, and show rx_data and the raw UART receive line, 900 cycles before and 100 after. Make it happen by reading SCRATCH.

brief_fifo_example.request: capture the UART byte when the FIFO overflows, 200 cycles before and 50 after

t1_or_flags.request: Capture count and duty when either win_wr or press_clear goes to 1, 8 cycles before and 64 after. To make it happen, wait 300 ms and then write 0x22 to DUTY.

t1_reuse_rise.request: After arming, write 0x0042 to COUNT. Capture count on the rising edge of win_wr, 4 cycles before and 8 after, then read COUNT back.
